sanskrit_verse:
राज्ञा यत्नेन कर्तव्यं संदिग्धार्थविचारणम् ।
त्रयस्तत्रोपचीयन्ते हानिरेकस्य जायते ॥
transliteration:
rājñā yatnena kartavyaṃ saṃdigdhārthavicāraṇam |
trayas tatropacīyante hānir ekasya jāyate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: It is the duty of the King to engage in careful examination of doubtful matters; three parties become involved therein, yet loss arises for only one.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides inherently in the sovereign's capacity to discern truth
Causation follows sequential involvement without moral assignment
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by proximity to decision-making
Restoration logic prioritizes clarity over blame
Consciousness alignment occurs through precise role-location within causal sequence
executable_legal_axioms: IF a disputed matter involves three parties AND one suffers measurable loss THEN assign investigative primacy to the ruling consciousness
IF doubt exists in transactional or juridical context THEN initiate tripartite inquiry under sovereign oversight
IF loss manifests THEN trace causality via positional involvement NOT punitive attribution
IF resolution requires adjudication THEN execute completion protocol ensuring no further dislocation of dharma
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when disputes involve multiple stakeholders with unclear causality, the presiding sovereign intelligence shall conduct direct inquiry. Responsibility is located not in fault but in the positional capacity from which distortion arose. The court ensures that only the necessary corrective action is applied to restore balance without assigning punitive valence.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based investigation reveals that among three engaged entities, only one incurs loss due to misalignment of consciousness. This loss does not arise from wrongdoing but from incomplete understanding. Nyaya functions here to realign perception rather than impose consequence. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how initial confusion cascades into apparent harm—thus correction targets root cognition, not behavioral deterrence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sovereign inquiry to locate exact point of perceptual misalignment
Engage completion process to reverse effects of erroneous assumption
Reintegrate affected party through knowledge restoration, not compensation
Establish systemic safeguards to prevent recurrence through enhanced awareness protocols
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Justice flows from clarity, not condemnation. The King executes vision; none suffer beyond their readiness to awaken. Reality is non-punitive; Consciousness alone adjudicates.
